## What this batch changed

Generated from `454315e`. Of the 174 rows, 156 are model drafts (60 calls,
$0.036849) and 18 are hand-authored (`model: "hand"`). The drafter emits one
memory id per call and `normalize()` enforces a single expected id, so it cannot
express the (c) two-memory composition cases; those 9 rows, plus 4 cold
questions and 5 near-miss negatives, are the hand additions.

Bucket counts: `agree` 136, `matcher-weak` 28, `precision-leak` 6,
`recall-gap` 4. Against batch 2 (119 rows) this batch leans harder on the three
under-covered failure modes, so the absolute disagreement count rises while the
per-row rate stays flat (38/174 vs 25/119).

**(a) Cold natural-language questions.** The four hand cold questions all hit on
`inject`, so the documented conjunctive miss is specific to `search`, not to the
inject planner. The 28 `matcher-weak` rows are mostly genuine natural questions,
but roughly ten are not: they are keyword-shaped phrases carrying extra
non-indexed tokens (`令牌刷新 token-refresh 这块怎么走的`,
`镜像标签 image-tag 命名规则`, `超时 默认值 覆盖 配置`,
`端口约定 port-rule 项目 p-memory-eval`). Rule 5 forbids those, and
`bucketOf()` files every search miss on a `hit` label under `matcher-weak`, so
the mislabels hide in a bucket that reads as "documented matcher property". They
should be shortened to the indexed phrase or moved to `inject`.

**(b) Near-miss negatives.** The 5 hand negatives each share one word/bigram
with the memory they forbid. Three stayed clean; `hand-b3-neg-pool-keepalive`
(`连接池`) leaked `mem-conn-pool` and `hand-b3-neg-apiver-header`
(`api-version`) leaked `mem-api-version`. The 4 generated cross-project
`precision-leak` rows are a different pattern — see below.

**(c) Composition.** The harness cannot score "both must surface": `score()`
resolves an expected set with `findIndex(id => expected.includes(id))`, so one of
two expected ids already scores a hit. Evidence from this run:
`hand-b3-comp-port-deploy` is `hit` with only `mem-deploy-port` injected
(`mem-port-rule-b` absent), `hand-b3-comp-log-stale` is `hit` with only
`mem-log-retention`, `hand-b3-scomp-pool-timeout` is `hit` with only
`mem-conn-pool`; `hand-b3-comp-monorepo-i18n` and
`hand-b3-scomp-deploy-port-rule` missed. Treat these 9 rows as labelled intent
for a future AND scorer, not as a claim this run enforces.

**Drafts I would relabel.**
- `p-memory-eval 这个项目用哪个端口部署？` (project `p-memory-eval-other`,
  forbids `mem-other-port`): the injected memory is the query's own scope; the
  reference and project are inverted.
- `在 p-shop 项目里，数据库迁移回滚要注意什么？` (project `p-memory-eval`,
  forbids `mem-migration`): names another project but runs in this scope, and
  `mem-migration` is the right reference here, not noise (rule 4). The
  `p-billing`/`密钥轮换` and `p-web-app`/`请求超时` leaks are the same shape.
- the ~10 over-specified search hits above (rule 5).
- The three `mem-archived` `recall-gap` rows are the open question: either
  archived memories are not reachable on `inject` (a real gap) or the three
  labels should be `none`.

**Update after the AND scorer (454315e + working tree).** `score()` now treats
several `expected_memory_ids` as an AND (`missing_expected_ids`), so the three
composition rows the worker flagged below moved from `agree` to `recall-gap`:
`agree` 136 → 133, `matcher-weak` 28 → 29, `recall-gap` 4 → 6. The table above is
regenerated with that scorer; the prose below is the worker's original reading.
Point (c) is therefore resolved as measurement, not as a labelling question: the
nine composition rows now assert that every needed memory surfaces.
